title: WorldReasoner: Evaluating Whether Language Model Agents Forecast Events with Valid Reasoning

claim.summary: WorldReasoner evaluates historical event forecasts using separate outcome, source-evidence, and hindsight-event-alignment measures under a simulated-date information boundary.

modules.name: Outcome, source, and hindsight-event evaluation
modules.scope_reason: Scores are defined for event forecasts and their retrieved articles/forecast graphs; the reference is a post-resolution event graph.

modules.name: Simulated-date retrieval gateway
modules.scope_reason: Timestamp filtering enforces an as-of information boundary for a dated article/event repository, independently of the event forecast scoring contract.
